page.overview:
Who is Inuarashi?

Duke Inuarashi is a canine mink. He was one of the two rulers of the Mokomo Dukedom, dubbed the "Ruler of Day", holding the position from 6:00 AM to 6:00 PM. He currently serves as the daimyo of Kuri.

Inuarashi and Nekomamushi served as retainers for the Kouzuki Family of Wano Country, as members of Kouzuki Oden's Nine Red Scabbards. The pair also followed Oden as he travelled with the Whitebeard Pirates and Roger Pirates. Pedro has claimed Inuarashi and Nekomamushi must not be allowed to die because "the world is waiting for them".

He is an ally of the Straw Hat Pirates during the Whole Cake Island Saga and the Wano Country Saga.

Inuarashi is an incredibly large and grizzled canine mink. He wears a small pair of blue sunglasses and has shoulder-length black ears, a white beard, and a large and bushy tail. Like all the retainers of the Kouzuki Family, Inuarashi bears the family crest somewhere on his body.
